title: Easier sign-in and password reset
notes: Stay signed in on your device for 30 days (ticked for you), so the password is not asked at every visit
Pressed "E-mail me a code" more than once? Any of your last three codes now works
New passwords need 8 characters (was 10), with a number or symbol
Administrators see who could not sign in, and why, under Settings > Sign-ins
